    # Use fixed-width format strings for obj1 to make sizing predictable

    def make_obj1(file_len, hints_off, hints_len, end_first, xref_off):
        return b"1 0 obj<</Linearized 1/L %05d/H[%05d %05d]/O 2/E %05d/N 1/T %05d>>endobj\n" % (
            file_len, hints_off, hints_len, end_first, xref_off)
    
    # Test obj1 length with dummy values
    obj1_len = len(make_obj1(99999, 99999, 99999, 99999, 99999))

    obj2_start = obj1_start + obj1_len
    
    obj2 = b"2 0 obj<</Type/Catalog/Pages 3 0 R>>endobj\n"
    obj3_start = obj2_start + len(obj2)
    
    obj3 = b"3 0 obj<</Type/Pages/Kids[4 0 R]/Count 1>>endobj\n"
    obj4_start = obj3_start + len(obj3)
    
    obj4 = b"4 0 obj<</Type/Page/Parent 3 0 R/MediaBox[0 0 612 792]>>endobj\n"
    
    xref_start = obj4_start + len(obj4)
    
    # Build xref
    xref = bytearray()
    xref.extend(b"xref\n0 5\n")
    xref.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    xref.extend(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % obj1_start)
    xref.extend(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % obj2_start)
    xref.extend(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % obj3_start)
    xref.extend(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % obj4_start)
    xref.extend(b"trailer<</Size 5/Root 2 0 R>>\n")
    xref.extend(b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_start)
    
    hints_offset = xref_start + len(xref)
    
    # Build hints stream data
    stream_data = bytearray()
    
    # Page offset table:
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 1))     # nObjectLeast = 1
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 0))     # objectOffsetFirst = 0
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsDiffObjects = 0
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 100))   # pageLengthLeast = 100
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsDiffPageLength = 0
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 0))     # OffsetStreamLeast
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsOffsetStream
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 0))     # lengthStreamLeast
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsLengthStream
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsNumShared
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsShared
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsNumerator
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # denominator
    # With nBitsDiffObjects=0, the loop reads 0 bits per page -> immediate
    # With nBitsDiffPageLength=0, same
    # With nBitsNumShared=0, same
    
    shared_offset = len(stream_data)
    
    # Shared objects table:
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 0))     # firstSharedObjectNumber
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 0))     # firstSharedObjectOffset
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 1))     # nSharedGroupsFirst = 1
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 1))     # nSharedGroups = 1
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsNumObjects
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">I", 100))   # groupLengthLeast
    stream_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))     # nBitsDiffGroupLength
    stream_data.extend(b"\x00" * 10)             # padding for per-group data
    
    stream_length = len(stream_data)
    
    # Build hints object header
    hints_header = b"5 0 obj<</Length %d/S %d>>stream\n" % (stream_length, shared_offset)
    hints_footer = b"\nendstream endobj\n"

    assert len(obj1) == obj1_len, f"obj1 length mismatch: {len(obj1)} vs {obj1_len}"

    pdf.extend(obj3)
    pdf.extend(obj4)
    pdf.extend(xref)
    pdf.extend(hints_header)
    pdf.extend(stream_data)
    pdf.extend(hints_footer)
    
    assert len(pdf) == total_len, f"total length mismatch: {len(pdf)} vs {total_len}"
    
    return bytes(pdf)

pdf_data = build_pdf()

    f.write(pdf_data)
